narration.transcript: Want the look of old timber beams without the weight? Meet Heritage Timber by Ekena Millwork. Each beam is cast from real, weathered timber, so it looks solid, even up close. A five and a half inch beam, twelve feet long, ships at about eighteen pounds. One person can lift it. It slides over a wood block with standard household tools, and it's hollow so it can hide wiring. And unlike solid wood, it resists warping and cracking with less upkeep. Pick from six hand-stained finishes, or primed, eight cross-section sizes in lengths from four to twenty-four feet. It's in stock and usually ships in three to five business days. Order a sample and see it in your own light.
